note: 200 request traces at each of four operating points. Every point serves the same task, so the input and output token distributions per request are the same everywhere. batch_size is the serving concurrency target and max_context_tokens is the configured context window, which sets how much KV cache the deployment reserves per slot. price_per_input_token_usd and price_per_output_token_usd are the published per-token prices to cost each call. A request that did not resolve was still computed and still billed.
